mechanism_claims.entity_scope: HPRP-A1 with DOX in HeLa cells
mechanism_claims.claim_text: Combination treatment increased early apoptosis and activated caspase-3, -8, and -9 relative to single agents.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Low-dose combination treatment reduced HeLa xenograft tumor volume/weight more than either single agent and increased apoptotic staining in tumor sections.
